rationale: The core dispute remains unresolved: labour, the state, and the works council still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management, investors, and the family still insist these instruments remain necessary if the savings gap cannot otherwise be closed. The last two rounds have hardened into repeated restatements with only procedural agreement on plant-level data and review mechanisms, so a targeted intervention is needed to break the circularity rather than continue the same exchange.
